versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this release.

- Version 1.0.10 matches the previous version; no modifications or updates have been made.

- Skill 名称由 `captcha-base-skill` 改为 `captcha-skill`。
- 明确注明云端兜底平台为“云码 JFBYM”，并补充了注册链接及平台主页说明。
- 增加了「调用边界摘要」一节，清晰描述何时有图片上传、token 传递、不读取系统凭据等隐私边界。
- 云端相关部分统一为“云码 API / JFBYM”，措辞更规范。
- 其余功能、接口和用法未变（本次仅为文档/元数据调整，不涉及代码层更改）。

- Added a new "云端与隐私说明" section to explicitly describe data and token usage, cloud endpoint, and privacy recommendations for sensitive scenarios.
- Clarifies that JFBYM_TOKEN is only required for cloud (paid) API calls; local (free) features do not need the token.
- Details that invoking cloud fallback will upload image data and the token to a third-party API (https://api.jfbym.com).
- Discloses existence of a developer tag for channel attribution and referral link for possible rebates.
- Removed the file _meta.json. No functional code/interface changes.

Version 1.0.9

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No user-facing features, fixes, or documentation updates.
